subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Obstruct
solution:
The correct answer is '**Curb**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Obstruct**' is '**Curb**'.
 
• **Obstruct**: to stop something from happening or somebody/something from moving either by accident or deliberately. [किसी के काम में अड़चन डालना या रुकावट पैदा करना (अनजाने में या जानबूझ कर)]
 
 
• *Example: Could you move on, please? You’re **obstructing** the traffic if you park there.*
 
 
 
• **Curb**: a control or limit on something. (नियंत्रण, रोक, अंकुश)
 
 
• *Example: a **curb** on local government spending...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Curb.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Replace**: to take the place of somebody/something; to use somebody/something in place of another person or thing. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का स्‍थान लेना; किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु के स्‍थान पर दूसरे को ले आना)
 
• **Release**: to allow somebody/something to be free. [व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को (किसी से या कहीं से) मुक्त करना, जाने देना]
 
• **Unclog**: remove accumulated matter from (a drain or other channel). [(एक नाली या अन्य चैनल) से संचित पदार्थ को हटा दें]
